name: 男の子（赤パーカー・持ち歩き）
author: kaede

source.prompt: PER-CELL nano edit over ../avatar-carry/sheet-original.png at the A-3 dense density (2026-08-20 — 12 walk cells per stride, owner ruling A-3 in the PR #129 thread; the recipe is 運転知見 41, adopted after the whole-sheet edit collapsed on host-side nano-banana-2 drift, 知見 40). The source sheet's 13 cells (380x414, grid thirteenths) were edited one cell at a time with google/nano-banana-2 (resolution 1K, $0.085/cell): the STAND cell is the morning 4-cell round's approved edit reused byte-identically (its prompt: 「This image is a single frame of a chibi game character standing on a flat pure green #00FF00 chroma-key background, holding his bent NEAR arm with a round mitten hand in front of his waist. Edit ONLY the clothes: replace the white short-sleeved shirt with a RED hooded sweatshirt (hoodie, long sleeves, a small hood resting on his back, a front pocket), and replace the navy pants with BEIGE chino pants, keeping his brown shoes; the long sleeves must follow the existing arm poses exactly — including the bent near arm with the mitten hand in front of the waist — hands stay bare skin. Keep everything else EXACTLY pixel-identical: the same face, eyes, hair, skin, shoes, body pose, arm and leg positions, framing, and green background.」); each of the 12 walk cells was edited with image_input = [the parent walk cell, that edited stand] — the stand anchors the outfit interpretation across cells — with the prompt 「The first image is a single frame of a chibi game character mid-walk on a flat pure green #00FF00 chroma-key background, holding his arms out in front of his waist with round mitten hands. The second image shows THE SAME character wearing his new outfit: a RED hooded sweatshirt (hoodie, long sleeves, a small hood resting on his back, a front pocket) and BEIGE chino pants with his brown shoes. Edit ONLY the clothes of the first image: dress him in EXACTLY the same red hoodie and beige chino pants as the second image — same colors, same shading style, same hood and front pocket; the long sleeves must follow the existing arm poses exactly — including the arms held out in front of the waist — the mitten hands stay bare skin. Keep everything else of the first image EXACTLY pixel-identical: the same face, eyes, hair, skin, shoes, body pose, arm and leg positions, framing, and green background.」. The 13 edited cells were reassembled into one 13-column green #00FF00 sheet (cell box 760x828, bottom-center aligned) = sheet-original.png, then imported by the standard lane (--from-stage import: chroma key, trim, stand-height scale, art lint + per-pose silhouette IoU vs the edit source's committed frames). Takes: all 12 walk cells one-shot; ART LINT PASS. Walk handAnchors = parent anchors snapped to skin (long sleeves shift the mitten +2..8px); neckAnchors transferred from the re-extracted avatar-carry manifest (13 poses).
